Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen Hazrat Ali Karam Allah Wajhahu Kofe ke mimbar par charh kar ek martaba farmane lage ke Quran-e-Kareem ki jis ayat ki baabat aur jis Sunnat-e-Rasool ﷺ ki baabat tum koi sawal karna chahte ho karlo. Is par Ibn-e-Al-Kwa ne khare ho kar pucha ke (Zariyat) se kya murad hai? Farmaya hawa, pucha (Hamilat) se? Farmaya abr. Kaha (Jariyat) se? Farmaya kashtiyan, kaha (Muqsimat) se? Farmaya farishte. Is bare mein ek marfoo' hadith bhi aayi hai. Bazzar mein hai (Sabeeh) Tamimi Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar ke paas aaya aur kaha batao (Zariyat) se kya murad hai? Farmaya hawa. Aur ise agar maine Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna huwa na hota toh main kabhi yeh matlab na kehta. Pucha (Muqsimat) se kya murad hai? Farmaya farishte aur ise bhi maine Huzoor ﷺ se sun rakha hai. Pucha (Jariyat) se kya matlab hai? Farmaya kashtiyan. Yeh bhi maine agar Rasool Allah ﷺ se na suna hota toh tujh se na kehta. Phir hukm diya ke ise sau kore lagaye jayein chunache ise darre mare gaye aur ek makan mein rakha gaya jab zakhm ache ho gaye toh bulwa kar phir kore patwaye, aur sawar kara kar Hazrat Abu Moosa ko likh bheja ke yeh kisi majlis mein na baithne paye. Kuch dinon baad yeh Hazrat Abu Moosa ke paas aaye aur bari sakht takeedi qasmein kha kar unhein yaqeen dilaya ke ab mere khayalat ki poori islaah ho chuki ab mere dil mein bad-itiqadi nahi rahi jo pehle thi. Chunache Hazrat Abu Moosa ne Janab Amir-ul-Momineen ki khidmat mein is ki itlaah di aur sath hi yeh bhi likha ke mera khayal hai ke ab woh waqai theek ho gaya hai. Is ke jawab mein darbar-e-khilafat se farman pucha ke phir unhein majlis mein baithne ki ijazat de di jaye. Imam Abu Bakr Bazzar farmate hain is ke do raawiyon mein kalam hai pas yeh hadith zaeef hai. Theek baat yeh maloom hoti hai ke yeh hadith bhi mawqoof hai yani Hazrat Umar ka apna farman hai marfoo' hadith nahi. Amir-ul-Momineen ne ise jo patwaya tha is ki wajah yeh thi ke is ki bad-itiqadi aap par zahir ho chuki thi aur is ke yeh sawalat az-roo-e-inkar aur mukhalifat ke thay wallahu alam. Sabeeh ke baap ka naam Asal tha aur is ka yeh qissa mashhoor hai jise poora poora Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir laye hain. Yahi tafsir Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Hazrat Mujahid, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Hasan, Hazrat Qatada, Hazrat Suddi waghaira se marwi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer aur Imam Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne in ayoton ki tafsir mein aur koi qaul وارد hi nahi kiya. Hamilat se murad abr hone ka muhawra is sher mein bhi paya jata hai:
Wa aslamtu nafsi liman aslamtu lahu
Al-muznu tahmilu azban zulala
Yaani main apne aap ko us Allah ka tabe-e-farman karta hoon jis ke tabe-e-farman woh baadal hain jo saaf shafaf meethe aur halkay pani ko utha kar le jate hain. Jariyat se murad baaz ne sitare liye hain jo asman par chalte phirte rehte hain. Yeh maana lene mein yani adna se aala ki taraf hogi. Awlan hawa phir baadal phir sitare phir farishte.

Jo kabhi Allah ka hukum le kar utarte hain kabhi koi supurd kardah kaam baja laane ke liye tashreef laate hain. Chunke yeh sab qasmein is baat par hain ki qayamat zaroor aani hai aur log dobara zinda kiye jayenge is liye in ke baad hi farmaya ki tumhein jo waada diya jata hai woh sachcha hai aur hisab kitab jaza saza zaroor waqie hone wali hai. Phir aasman ki qasam khayi jo khoobsurti raunaq husn aur barabari wala hai bahut se salaf ne yehi maani (hubuk) ke bayan kiye hain Hazrat Zahhak wagairah farmate hain ki pani ki maujein, reet ke zaray, khetiyon ke patte hawa ke zor se jab lahrate hain aur pur shikan lahraye daar hojate hain aur goya in mein raaste padjate hain isi ko hubuk kehte hain, Ibn Jareer ki ek hadees mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain tumhare peeche kazzab behkane wala hai us ke sar ke baal peeche ki taraf se hubuk hubuk hain yaani ghonghar wale. Abu Salih farmate hain hubuk se muraad shiddat wala Khasif kehte hain muraad khush manzar hai. Hasan Basri farmate hain is ki khoobsurti is ke sitare hain Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar farmate hain is se muraad saatwan aasman hai mumkin hai aap ka matlab yeh ho ki qaim rehne wale sitare is aasman mein hain aksar ulama-e-haiyat ka bayan hai ki yeh aathwein aasman mein hain jo saatwein ke upar hai wallahu alam in tamam aqwal ka mahasil ek hi hai yaani husn o raunaq wala aasman. Is ki bulandi, safai, pakeezgi, banawat ki amdagi, is ki mazbooti, is ki chaudai aur kashadgi, is ka sitaron ka jagmagana, jin mein se baaz chalte phirte rehte hain aur baaz tehre hue hain is ka sooraj aur chaand jaise sayyaron se muzayyin hona yeh sab is ki khoobsurti aur amdagi ki cheezein hain phir farmata hai aye mushriko tum apne hi aqwal mein mukhtalif aur muztarib ho tum kisi sahih nateeje par ab tak khud apne taur par bhi nahi pahuche ho. Kisi raaye par tumhara ijtima nahi, Hazrat Qatada farmate hain ki in mein se baaz to Quran ko sachcha jaante the baaz is ki takzeeb karte the. Phir farmata hai yeh halat isi ki hoti hai jo khud gumrah ho. Woh apne aise batil aqwal ki wajah se behak aur bhatak jata hai sahih samajh aur sachcha ilm is se faut hojata hai jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (illa man huwa salal-jahim) (Surah As-Saffat: 163) yaani tum log ma' apne ma'boodan-e-batil ke siwaye jahannami logon ke kisi ko behka nahi sakte Hazrat Ibn Abbas aur Suddi farmate hain is se gumrah wahi hota hai jo khud behka huwa ho. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain is se door wahi hota hai jo bhalaiyon se door daal diya gaya hai Hazrat Imam Hasan Basri farmate hain Quran se wahi hatta hai jo use pehle hi se jhutlane par kamar kas liye ho phir farmata hai ki be-sanad baatein kehne wale halak hon yaani jhooti baatein banane wale jinhein yaqeen na tha jo kehte the ki hum uthaye nahi jayenge Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain yaani shak karne wale maloon hain.

Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmaate hain yaani shak karne wale maloon hain, Hazrat Muaz bhi apne khutbe mein yehi farmaate the, yeh dhoke wale aur bad-guman log hain. Phir farmaya jo log apne kufr-o-shak mein gafil aur be-parwah hain. Yeh log az-ru-e-inkar poochte hain ki jaza ka din kab aayega? Allah farmata hai us din to yeh aag mein tapaye jayenge jis tarah sona tapaya jata hai, yeh is mein jaleenge aur in se kaha jayega ki jalne ka maza chakho. Apne kartoot ke badle bardasht karo. Phir in ki aur zyada haqarat ke liye in se ba-taur dant-dapat ke kaha jayega yehi hai jis ki jaldi macha rahe the ki kab aayega kab aayega, wallahu A'lam.

Al-muznu tahmilu azban zulala
Yaani main apne aap ko us Allah ka tabe-e-farman karta hoon jis ke tabe-e-farman woh baadal hain jo saaf shafaf meethe aur halkay pani ko utha kar le jate hain. Jo kabhi Allah ka hukum le kar utarte hain kabhi koi supurd kardah kaam baja laane ke liye tashreef laate hain. Chunke yeh sab qasmein is baat par hain ki qayamat zaroor aani hai aur log dobara zinda kiye jayenge is liye in ke baad hi farmaya ki tumhein jo waada diya jata hai woh sachcha hai aur hisab kitab jaza saza zaroor waqie hone wali hai. Phir aasman ki qasam khayi jo khoobsurti raunaq husn aur barabari wala hai bahut se salaf ne yehi maani (hubuk) ke bayan kiye hain Hazrat Zahhak wagairah farmate hain ki pani ki maujein, reet ke zaray, khetiyon ke patte hawa ke zor se jab lahrate hain aur pur shikan lahraye daar hojate hain aur goya in mein raaste padjate hain isi ko hubuk kehte hain, Ibn Jareer ki ek hadees mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain tumhare peeche kazzab behkane wala hai us ke sar ke baal peeche ki taraf se hubuk hubuk hain yaani ghonghar wale. Abu Salih farmate hain hubuk se muraad shiddat wala Khasif kehte hain muraad khush manzar hai. Hasan Basri farmate hain is ki khoobsurti is ke sitare hain Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar farmate hain is se muraad saatwan aasman hai mumkin hai aap ka matlab yeh ho ki qaim rehne wale sitare is aasman mein hain aksar ulama-e-haiyat ka bayan hai ki yeh aathwein aasman mein hain jo saatwein ke upar hai wallahu alam in tamam aqwal ka mahasil ek hi hai yaani husn o raunaq wala aasman. Is ki bulandi, safai, pakeezgi, banawat ki amdagi, is ki mazbooti, is ki chaudai aur kashadgi, is ka sitaron ka jagmagana, jin mein se baaz chalte phirte rehte hain aur baaz tehre hue hain is ka sooraj aur chaand jaise sayyaron se muzayyin hona yeh sab is ki khoobsurti aur amdagi ki cheezein hain phir farmata hai aye mushriko tum apne hi aqwal mein mukhtalif aur muztarib ho tum kisi sahih nateeje par ab tak khud apne taur par bhi nahi pahuche ho. Kisi raaye par tumhara ijtima nahi, Hazrat Qatada farmate hain ki in mein se baaz to Quran ko sachcha jaante the baaz is ki takzeeb karte the. Phir farmata hai yeh halat isi ki hoti hai jo khud gumrah ho. Phir aasman ki qasam khayi jo khoobsurti raunaq husn aur barabari wala hai bahut se salaf ne yehi maani (hubuk) ke bayan kiye hain Hazrat Zahhak wagairah farmate hain ki pani ki maujein, reet ke zaray, khetiyon ke patte hawa ke zor se jab lahrate hain aur pur shikan lahraye daar hojate hain aur goya in mein raaste padjate hain isi ko hubuk kehte hain, Ibn Jareer ki ek hadees mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain tumhare peeche kazzab behkane wala hai us ke sar ke baal peeche ki taraf se hubuk hubuk hain yaani ghonghar wale. Abu Salih farmate hain hubuk se muraad shiddat wala Khasif kehte hain muraad khush manzar hai. Hasan Basri farmate hain is ki khoobsurti is ke sitare hain Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar farmate hain is se muraad saatwan aasman hai mumkin hai aap ka matlab yeh ho ki qaim rehne wale sitare is aasman mein hain aksar ulama-e-haiyat ka bayan hai ki yeh aathwein aasman mein hain jo saatwein ke upar hai wallahu alam in tamam aqwal ka mahasil ek hi hai yaani husn o raunaq wala aasman. Is ki bulandi, safai, pakeezgi, banawat ki amdagi, is ki mazbooti, is ki chaudai aur kashadgi, is ka sitaron ka jagmagana, jin mein se baaz chalte phirte rehte hain aur baaz tehre hue hain is ka sooraj aur chaand jaise sayyaron se muzayyin hona yeh sab is ki khoobsurti aur amdagi ki cheezein hain phir farmata hai aye mushriko tum apne hi aqwal mein mukhtalif aur muztarib ho tum kisi sahih nateeje par ab tak khud apne taur par bhi nahi pahuche ho. Kisi raaye par tumhara ijtima nahi, Hazrat Qatada farmate hain ki in mein se baaz to Quran ko sachcha jaante the baaz is ki takzeeb karte the. Phir farmata hai yeh halat isi ki hoti hai jo khud gumrah ho. Woh apne aise batil aqwal ki wajah se behak aur bhatak jata hai sahih samajh aur sachcha ilm is se faut hojata hai jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (illa man huwa salal-jahim) (Surah As-Saffat: 163) yaani tum log ma' apne ma'boodan-e-batil ke siwaye jahannami logon ke kisi ko behka nahi sakte Hazrat Ibn Abbas aur Suddi farmate hain is se gumrah wahi hota hai jo khud behka huwa ho. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain is se door wahi hota hai jo bhalaiyon se door daal diya gaya hai Hazrat Imam Hasan Basri farmate hain Quran se wahi hatta hai jo use pehle hi se jhutlane par kamar kas liye ho phir farmata hai ki be-sanad baatein kehne wale halak hon yaani jhooti baatein banane wale jinhein yaqeen na tha jo kehte the ki hum uthaye nahi jayenge Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain yaani shak karne wale maloon hain.

Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmaate hain yaani shak karne wale maloon hain, Hazrat Muaz bhi apne khutbe mein yehi farmaate the, yeh dhoke wale aur bad-guman log hain. Phir farmaya jo log apne kufr-o-shak mein gafil aur be-parwah hain. Yeh log az-ru-e-inkar poochte hain ki jaza ka din kab aayega? Allah farmata hai us din to yeh aag mein tapaye jayenge jis tarah sona tapaya jata hai, yeh is mein jaleenge aur in se kaha jayega ki jalne ka maza chakho. Apne kartoot ke badle bardasht karo. Phir in ki aur zyada haqarat ke liye in se ba-taur dant-dapat ke kaha jayega yehi hai jis ki jaldi macha rahe the ki kab aayega kab aayega, wallahu A'lam.

Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen Hazrat Ali Karam Allah Wajhahu Kofe ke mimbar par charh kar ek martaba farmane lage ke Quran-e-Kareem ki jis ayat ki baabat aur jis Sunnat-e-Rasool ﷺ ki baabat tum koi sawal karna chahte ho karlo. Is par Ibn-e-Al-Kwa ne khare ho kar pucha ke (Zariyat) se kya murad hai? Farmaya hawa, pucha (Hamilat) se? Farmaya abr. Kaha (Jariyat) se? Farmaya kashtiyan, kaha (Muqsimat) se? Farmaya farishte. Is bare mein ek marfoo' hadith bhi aayi hai. Bazzar mein hai (Sabeeh) Tamimi Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar ke paas aaya aur kaha batao (Zariyat) se kya murad hai? Farmaya hawa. Aur ise agar maine Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna huwa na hota toh main kabhi yeh matlab na kehta. Pucha (Muqsimat) se kya murad hai? Farmaya farishte aur ise bhi maine Huzoor ﷺ se sun rakha hai. Pucha (Jariyat) se kya matlab hai? Farmaya kashtiyan. Yeh bhi maine agar Rasool Allah ﷺ se na suna hota toh tujh se na kehta. Phir hukm diya ke ise sau kore lagaye jayein chunache ise darre mare gaye aur ek makan mein rakha gaya jab zakhm ache ho gaye toh bulwa kar phir kore patwaye, aur sawar kara kar Hazrat Abu Moosa ko likh bheja ke yeh kisi majlis mein na baithne paye. Kuch dinon baad yeh Hazrat Abu Moosa ke paas aaye aur bari sakht takeedi qasmein kha kar unhein yaqeen dilaya ke ab mere khayalat ki poori islaah ho chuki ab mere dil mein bad-itiqadi nahi rahi jo pehle thi. Chunache Hazrat Abu Moosa ne Janab Amir-ul-Momineen ki khidmat mein is ki itlaah di aur sath hi yeh bhi likha ke mera khayal hai ke ab woh waqai theek ho gaya hai. Is ke jawab mein darbar-e-khilafat se farman pucha ke phir unhein majlis mein baithne ki ijazat de di jaye. Imam Abu Bakr Bazzar farmate hain is ke do raawiyon mein kalam hai pas yeh hadith zaeef hai. Theek baat yeh maloom hoti hai ke yeh hadith bhi mawqoof hai yani Hazrat Umar ka apna farman hai marfoo' hadith nahi. Amir-ul-Momineen ne ise jo patwaya tha is ki wajah yeh thi ke is ki bad-itiqadi aap par zahir ho chuki thi aur is ke yeh sawalat az-roo-e-inkar aur mukhalifat ke thay wallahu alam. Sabeeh ke baap ka naam Asal tha aur is ka yeh qissa mashhoor hai jise poora poora Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir laye hain. Yahi tafsir Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Hazrat Mujahid, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Hasan, Hazrat Qatada, Hazrat Suddi waghaira se marwi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer aur Imam Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne in ayoton ki tafsir mein aur koi qaul وارد hi nahi kiya. Hamilat se murad abr hone ka muhawra is sher mein bhi paya jata hai:

Abu Salih farmate hain hubuk se muraad shiddat wala Khasif kehte hain muraad khush manzar hai. Hasan Basri farmate hain is ki khoobsurti is ke sitare hain Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar farmate hain is se muraad saatwan aasman hai mumkin hai aap ka matlab yeh ho ki qaim rehne wale sitare is aasman mein hain aksar ulama-e-haiyat ka bayan hai ki yeh aathwein aasman mein hain jo saatwein ke upar hai wallahu alam in tamam aqwal ka mahasil ek hi hai yaani husn o raunaq wala aasman. Is ki bulandi, safai, pakeezgi, banawat ki amdagi, is ki mazbooti, is ki chaudai aur kashadgi, is ka sitaron ka jagmagana, jin mein se baaz chalte phirte rehte hain aur baaz tehre hue hain is ka sooraj aur chaand jaise sayyaron se muzayyin hona yeh sab is ki khoobsurti aur amdagi ki cheezein hain phir farmata hai aye mushriko tum apne hi aqwal mein mukhtalif aur muztarib ho tum kisi sahih nateeje par ab tak khud apne taur par bhi nahi pahuche ho. Kisi raaye par tumhara ijtima nahi, Hazrat Qatada farmate hain ki in mein se baaz to Quran ko sachcha jaante the baaz is ki takzeeb karte the. Phir farmata hai yeh halat isi ki hoti hai jo khud gumrah ho. Woh apne aise batil aqwal ki wajah se behak aur bhatak jata hai sahih samajh aur sachcha ilm is se faut hojata hai jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (illa man huwa salal-jahim) (Surah As-Saffat: 163) yaani tum log ma' apne ma'boodan-e-batil ke siwaye jahannami logon ke kisi ko behka nahi sakte Hazrat Ibn Abbas aur Suddi farmate hain is se gumrah wahi hota hai jo khud behka huwa ho. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain is se door wahi hota hai jo bhalaiyon se door daal diya gaya hai Hazrat Imam Hasan Basri farmate hain Quran se wahi hatta hai jo use pehle hi se jhutlane par kamar kas liye ho phir farmata hai ki be-sanad baatein kehne wale halak hon yaani jhooti baatein banane wale jinhein yaqeen na tha jo kehte the ki hum uthaye nahi jayenge Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain yaani shak karne wale maloon hain.

Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmaate hain yaani shak karne wale maloon hain, Hazrat Muaz bhi apne khutbe mein yehi farmaate the, yeh dhoke wale aur bad-guman log hain. Phir farmaya jo log apne kufr-o-shak mein gafil aur be-parwah hain. Yeh log az-ru-e-inkar poochte hain ki jaza ka din kab aayega? Allah farmata hai us din to yeh aag mein tapaye jayenge jis tarah sona tapaya jata hai, yeh is mein jaleenge aur in se kaha jayega ki jalne ka maza chakho. Apne kartoot ke badle bardasht karo. Phir in ki aur zyada haqarat ke liye in se ba-taur dant-dapat ke kaha jayega yehi hai jis ki jaldi macha rahe the ki kab aayega kab aayega, wallahu A'lam.

Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen Hazrat Ali Karam Allah Wajhahu Kofe ke mimbar par charh kar ek martaba farmane lage ke Quran-e-Kareem ki jis ayat ki baabat aur jis Sunnat-e-Rasool ﷺ ki baabat tum koi sawal karna chahte ho karlo. Is par Ibn-e-Al-Kwa ne khare ho kar pucha ke (Zariyat) se kya murad hai? Farmaya hawa, pucha (Hamilat) se? Farmaya abr. Kaha (Jariyat) se? Farmaya kashtiyan, kaha (Muqsimat) se? Farmaya farishte. Is bare mein ek marfoo' hadith bhi aayi hai. Bazzar mein hai (Sabeeh) Tamimi Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar ke paas aaya aur kaha batao (Zariyat) se kya murad hai? Farmaya hawa. Aur ise agar maine Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna huwa na hota toh main kabhi yeh matlab na kehta. Pucha (Muqsimat) se kya murad hai? Farmaya farishte aur ise bhi maine Huzoor ﷺ se sun rakha hai. Pucha (Jariyat) se kya matlab hai? Farmaya kashtiyan. Yeh bhi maine agar Rasool Allah ﷺ se na suna hota toh tujh se na kehta. Phir hukm diya ke ise sau kore lagaye jayein chunache ise darre mare gaye aur ek makan mein rakha gaya jab zakhm ache ho gaye toh bulwa kar phir kore patwaye, aur sawar kara kar Hazrat Abu Moosa ko likh bheja ke yeh kisi majlis mein na baithne paye. Kuch dinon baad yeh Hazrat Abu Moosa ke paas aaye aur bari sakht takeedi qasmein kha kar unhein yaqeen dilaya ke ab mere khayalat ki poori islaah ho chuki ab mere dil mein bad-itiqadi nahi rahi jo pehle thi. Chunache Hazrat Abu Moosa ne Janab Amir-ul-Momineen ki khidmat mein is ki itlaah di aur sath hi yeh bhi likha ke mera khayal hai ke ab woh waqai theek ho gaya hai. Is ke jawab mein darbar-e-khilafat se farman pucha ke phir unhein majlis mein baithne ki ijazat de di jaye. Imam Abu Bakr Bazzar farmate hain is ke do raawiyon mein kalam hai pas yeh hadith zaeef hai. Theek baat yeh maloom hoti hai ke yeh hadith bhi mawqoof hai yani Hazrat Umar ka apna farman hai marfoo' hadith nahi. Amir-ul-Momineen ne ise jo patwaya tha is ki wajah yeh thi ke is ki bad-itiqadi aap par zahir ho chuki thi aur is ke yeh sawalat az-roo-e-inkar aur mukhalifat ke thay wallahu alam. Sabeeh ke baap ka naam Asal tha aur is ka yeh qissa mashhoor hai jise poora poora Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir laye hain. Yahi tafsir Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Hazrat Mujahid, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Hasan, Hazrat Qatada, Hazrat Suddi waghaira se marwi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer aur Imam Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne in ayoton ki tafsir mein aur koi qaul وارد hi nahi kiya. Hamilat se murad abr hone ka muhawra is sher mein bhi paya jata hai:
Wa aslamtu nafsi liman aslamtu lahu
Al-muznu tahmilu azban zulala
Yaani main apne aap ko us Allah ka tabe-e-farman karta hoon jis ke tabe-e-farman woh baadal hain jo saaf shafaf meethe aur halkay pani ko utha kar le jate hain. Jariyat se murad baaz ne sitare liye hain jo asman par chalte phirte rehte hain. Yeh maana lene mein yani adna se aala ki taraf hogi. Awlan hawa phir baadal phir sitare phir farishte.

Hasan-e-Karkardagi ke Inaamat: Parhezgaar Allah se darne wale logon ka anjaam bayan ho raha hai ke yeh Qiyamat ke din jannaton mein aur nahron mein honge, ba-khilaf un bad-kirdaaron ke jo azaab-o-saza, tauq-o-zanjeer, sakhti aur maar-peet mein honge. Jo faraaiz-e-Ilahi un ke paas aaye the yeh un ke aamil the aur un se pehle bhi woh ikhlaas se kaam karne wale the. Lekin is tafsir mein zara tamammul hai do wajah se: Awwal toh yeh ke yeh tafsir Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki kahi jaati hai lekin sanad sahih se un tak nahi pahunchti balki is ki yeh sanad bilkul zaeef hai. Doosre yeh ke (Akhizeen) ka laafz haal hai agle jumle se, toh yeh matlab hua ke muttaqi log jannat mein Allah ki di hui naimatein haasil kar rahe honge is se pehle woh bhalayi ke kaam karne wale the yaani duniya mein, jaise Allah Ta'ala Jala Jalaluhu ne aur aayaton mein farmaya, ayat: Kulu washrabu haniam bima aslaftum fil-ayyamil-khaliyah (Surah Al-Haaqqah: 24). Yaani dar-e-duniya mein tum ne jo nekiyan ki thin un ke badle ab tum yahan shauq se pakeeza-o-pasandeeda khatay peetay raho. 

Phir Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala un ke amal ke ikhlaas yaani un ke ehsaan ki tafseel bayan farma raha hai ke yeh raat ko bahut kam soya karte the. Baaz mafassireen kehte hain yahan (maa) nafiya hai toh ba-qaul Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera yeh matlab hoga ke un par koi raat aisi na guzarti thi jis ka kuch hissa yaad-e-Ilahi mein na guzaarte hon, khwah awwal waqt mein kuch nawafil parh lein khwah darmiyan mein. Yaani kuch na kuch kisi na kisi waqt namaz umoman har raat parh hi liya karte the, sari raat sotay sotay nahi guzaarte the. Hazrat Abul Aliyah waghera farmate hain yeh log Maghrib-o-Isha ke darmiyan kuch nawafil parh liya karte the. Imam Abu Jafar Baqir farmate hain murad yeh hai ke Isha ki namaz parhne se pehle nahi sotay the. Baaz mafassireen ka qaul hai ke (maa) yahan mausoolah hai yaani un ki neend raat ki kam thi, kuch sotay the kuch jaagte the aur agar dil lag gaya toh subah ho jaati thi aur phir pichli raat ko Janab-e-Bari mein gar-garakar tauba-e-istighfaar karte the. Hazrat Ahnaf bin Qais is ayat ka yeh matlab bayan kar ke phir farmate the: Afsos mujh mein yeh baat nahi! 

Aap ke shagird Hasan Basri (R.H) ka qaul hai ke aap aksar farmaya karte the: Jannatiyon ke jo aamaal aur jo sifaat bayan hue hain, main jab kabhi apne aamaal-o-sifaat ko un ke muqable mein rakhta hoon toh bahut kuch faasla pata hoon. Lekin Alhamdulillah, jahannumiyon ke aqaaid ke bil-muqabil jab main apne aqaaid ko lata hoon toh main dekhta hoon ke woh log toh bilkul hi khair se khali the, woh Kitabullah ke munkar, woh Rasulullah (ﷺ) ke munkar, woh maut ke baad ki zindagi ke munkar; pas hamari toh haalat wahi hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne is qisam ke logon ki batai hai: Khalata amalan salihan wa akharu sayyi'an asallahu an yatuba alaihim inna Allaha Ghafoorur Rahim (Surah At-Tawbah: 102). Yaani nekiyan badiyan mili juli.

Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam se qabeela Banu Tamim ke ek shakhs ne kaha, "Aiye Abu Salma! Yeh sifat toh hum mein nahi pai jati ke hum raat ko bahut kam sote hon, balki hum toh bahut kam waqt ibaadat Allah mein guzaarte hain." Toh aap ne farmaya, "Woh shakhs bhi bahut hi khush naseeb hai jo neend aaye toh so jaye aur jaage toh Allah se darta rahe." 

Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam farmate hain, "Jab shuru shuru mein Rasool Allah ﷺ Madina Shareef mein tashreef laaye, toh log aap ki ziyarat ke liye toot pade aur is majma mein main bhi tha. Wallah! Aap ke mubarak chehra par nazar padte hi itna toh maine yaqin kar liya ke yeh noorani chehra kisi jhoote insaan ka nahi ho sakta." 

Sab se pehli baat jo Rasool Kareem ﷺ ki mere kaan mein padi yeh thi ke aap ne yeh farmaya, "Aiye logo! Khana khilate raho aur silah rehmi karte raho aur salam kiya karo aur raaton ko jab log soye hue hon namaz ada karo, toh tum salamati ke sath jannat mein dakhil ho jaoge." 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke jannat mein aise baala khane hain jin ke andar ka hissa baahar se aur baahar ka hissa andar se nazar aata hai. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari ne farmaya, "Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Yeh kin ke liye hain?" Farmaya, "Un ke liye jo narm kalaam karein aur dusron ko khilate pilate rahein aur jab log sote hon yeh namazein padhein." 

Hazrat Zuhri aur Hazrat Hasan farmate hain is aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke woh raat ka aksar hissa tahajjud guzaari mein nikaal karte hain. Hazrat Ibn Abbas aur Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke raat ka bahut kam hissa woh sote hain. Hazrat Dahhak (Kanu qalila) ko is se pehle ke jumle ke sath milate hain aur (Minal-lail) se ibtida batate hain, lekin is qaul mein bahut doori aur takalluf hai. 

Phir Allah Azza-wa-Jal irshad farmata hai: Sahar ke waqt woh istighfar karte hain. Mujahid waghairah farmate hain yaani namaz padhte hain aur mufassireen farmate hain raaton ko qiyam karte hain aur subah ke hone ke waqt apne gunaahon ki muaafi talab karte hain, jaise aur jagah farman-e-bari hai: Ayat (Wal-mustaghfirina bil-ashtar) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 17) yaani sahar ke waqt yeh log istighfar karne lag jaate hain. 

Agar yeh istighfar namaz mein hi ho toh bhi bahut acha hai. Sihah waghairah mein sahaba ki ek jama'at ki kayi riwayaton se sabit hai ke Rasool Maqbool ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab aakhri tihai raat baqi reh jaati hai, us waqt Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala har raat ko aasman-e-dunya ki taraf utarta hai aur farmata hai: Koi gunahgaar hai? Jo tauba kare aur main us ki tauba qabool karoon. Koi istighfar karne wala hai? Jo istighfar kare aur main use bakhshun. Koi mangne wala hai? Jo maange aur main use doon." Fajr ke طلوع (tulu) hone tak yehi farmata hai. 

Aksar mufassireen ne farmaya ke Nabiyullah Hazrat Yaqoob ne apne ladkon se jo farmaya tha ke aayat (Sawfa astaghfiru lakum Rabbi innahu Huwal-Ghafoor-ur-Raheem) (12. Yusuf: 98) "Main ab anqareeb tumhare liye istighfar karunga," is se bhi matlab yehi tha ke sahar ka waqt jab aayega tab istighfar karunga.

Phir un ka yeh wasaf bayan kiya jata hai kay jahan yeh namazi hain aur haq-e-Allah ada karte hain wahan logon ke haq bhi nahi bhoolte, zakat dete hain, sulook, ehsan aur silah-e-rahmi karte hain. In ke maal mein aik muqarrara hissa mangne walon aur un haqdaroon ka hai jo sawal se bachte hain. Abu Dawood waghera mein hai, Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ farmate hain: Sail ka haq hai go woh ghor sawar ho. (Mahroom) woh hai jis ka koi hissa Bait-ul-Mal mein na ho, khud us ke paas koi kaam kaj na ho, sanat-o-hirfat yaad na ho jis se rozi kama sake. 

Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa R.A farmati hain: Is se murad woh log hain ke kuch silsila kamane ka kar rakha hai lekin itna nahi pate ke unhe kafi ho jaye. Hazrat Dahhak farmate hain: Woh shakhs jo maldar tha lekin maal tabah ho gaya, chunache Yamamah mein jab pani ki tughyani aayi aur aik shakhs ka tamam maal asbab baha le gayi to aik Sahabi ne farmaya yeh mahroom hai. Aur buzurg mufassireen farmate hain: Mahroom se murad woh shakhs hai jo hajat ke bawajood kisi se sawal nahi karta. 

Aik hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: Miskeen sirf woh log nahi jo ghoomte phirte hain aur jinhe aik do luqme ya aik do khajooren tum de diya karte ho, balke haqeeqat mein woh log bhi miskeen hain jo itna nahi pate ke unhe hajat na rahe, apna haal-o-qaal aisa rakhte hain ke kisi par un ki hajat-o-aflas zahir ho aur koi unhe sadqa de (Bukhari o Muslim). 

Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H Makkah Sharif ja rahe the ke raste mein aik kutta paas aa kar khada ho gaya, aap ne zibah karda bakri ka aik shana kaat kar us ki taraf daal diya aur farmaya log kehte hain yeh bhi mahroom mein se hain. 

Hazrat Sha'bi farmate hain: Main to aajiz aa gaya lekin mahroom ke maani maloom na kar saka. 

Imam Ibn Jareer farmate hain: Mahroom woh hai jis ke paas maal na raha ho, khwah wajah kuch bhi ho. Yaani hasil hi na kar saka, kamane khane ka saleeqa hi na ho, ya kaam hi na chalta ho, ya kisi aafat ke baais jama shuda maal zaya ho gaya ho waghera. 

Aik martaba Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne aik chhota sa lashkar kafiron ki sarkoobi ke liye rawana farmaya, Allah ne unhe ghalba diya aur maal-e-ghaneemat bhi mila, phir kuch log aap ke paas woh bhi aa gaye jo ghanimat hasil hone ke waqt mojood na the, pas yeh ayat utri. Is ka iqtiza to yeh hai ke yeh Madani ho lekin darasal aisa nahi balke yeh ayat Makki hai. 

Phir farmata hai: Yaqeen rakhne walon ke liye zameen mein bhi bohat se nishanat-e-qudrat mojood hain jo Khaliq ki azmat-o-izzat, haibat-o-jalalat par dalalat karte hain. Dekho ke kis tarah is mein hawanat aur nabatat ko phaila diya hai aur kis tarah is mein paharon, maidanon, samundaron aur daryon ko rawan kiya hai. Phir insan par nazar dalo, un ke zubanon ke ikhtilaf ko, un ke rang-o-roop ke ikhtilaf ko, un ke iradon aur quwwaton ke ikhtilaf ko, un ki aql-o-fahm ke ikhtilaf ko, un ki harkat-o-sakanat ko, un ki neki badi ko dekho, un ki banawat par ghor karo ke har uzu kaisi munasib jagah hai.

Isi liye uske baad hi farmaya khud tumhare wajood mein hi iski bahut si nishaniyan hain. Kya tum dekhte nahi ho? Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain jo shakhs apni paidaish mein ghaor karega apne jodon ki tarkeb par nazar daalega woh yaqeen karlega ke beshak ise Allah ne hi paida kiya aur apni ibaadat ke liye hi banaya hai. Phir farmata hai aasmaan mein tumhari rozi hai yaani baarish aur woh bhi jiska tumse wada kiya jata hai yaani Jannat, Hazrat Wasil Ahdab ne is ayat ki tilaawat ki aur farmaya afsos mera rizq toh aasmaano mein hai aur main ise zameen mein talaash kar raha hoon? Yeh keh kar basti chhodi ujaad jangal mein chale gaye. Teen din tak toh unhe kuch bhi na mila lekin teesre din dekhte hain ke tar khajuroon ka ek khosha unke paas rakha hua hai. Unke bhai sath hi the dono bhai aakhri dam tak isi tarah janglo mein rahe. Phir Allah Kareem khud apni qasam kha kar farmata hai ke mere jo waade hain masalan Qiyamat ke din dobara zinda karne ka jaza saza ka yeh yaqeenan sarasar sachche aur qatan beshabah ho kar rehne wale hain, jaise tumhari zubaan se nikle hue alfaaz mein shak nahi hota usi tarah tumhe in mein bhi koi shak hargiz hargiz nahi karna chahiye. Hazrat Muaz jab koi baat kehte toh farmate yeh bilkul haq hai jaise ke tera yahan hona haq hai. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Allah unhe barbaad kare jo Allah ki qasam ko bhi na maane yeh hadith mursal hai yaani tabi Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se riwayat karte hain. Sahabi ka naam nahi lete.

Hasan-e-Karkardagi ke Inaamat: Parhezgaar Allah se darne wale logon ka anjaam bayan ho raha hai ke yeh Qiyamat ke din jannaton mein aur nahron mein honge, ba-khilaf un bad-kirdaaron ke jo azaab-o-saza, tauq-o-zanjeer, sakhti aur maar-peet mein honge. Jo faraaiz-e-Ilahi un ke paas aaye the yeh un ke aamil the aur un se pehle bhi woh ikhlaas se kaam karne wale the. Lekin is tafsir mein zara tamammul hai do wajah se: Awwal toh yeh ke yeh tafsir Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki kahi jaati hai lekin sanad sahih se un tak nahi pahunchti balki is ki yeh sanad bilkul zaeef hai. Doosre yeh ke (Akhizeen) ka laafz haal hai agle jumle se, toh yeh matlab hua ke muttaqi log jannat mein Allah ki di hui naimatein haasil kar rahe honge is se pehle woh bhalayi ke kaam karne wale the yaani duniya mein, jaise Allah Ta'ala Jala Jalaluhu ne aur aayaton mein farmaya, ayat: Kulu washrabu haniam bima aslaftum fil-ayyamil-khaliyah (Surah Al-Haaqqah: 24). Yaani dar-e-duniya mein tum ne jo nekiyan ki thin un ke badle ab tum yahan shauq se pakeeza-o-pasandeeda khatay peetay raho. 

Phir Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala un ke amal ke ikhlaas yaani un ke ehsaan ki tafseel bayan farma raha hai ke yeh raat ko bahut kam soya karte the. Baaz mafassireen kehte hain yahan (maa) nafiya hai toh ba-qaul Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera yeh matlab hoga ke un par koi raat aisi na guzarti thi jis ka kuch hissa yaad-e-Ilahi mein na guzaarte hon, khwah awwal waqt mein kuch nawafil parh lein khwah darmiyan mein. Yaani kuch na kuch kisi na kisi waqt namaz umoman har raat parh hi liya karte the, sari raat sotay sotay nahi guzaarte the. Imam Abu Jafar Baqir farmate hain murad yeh hai ke Isha ki namaz parhne se pehle nahi sotay the. Baaz mafassireen ka qaul hai ke (maa) yahan mausoolah hai yaani un ki neend raat ki kam thi, kuch sotay the kuch jaagte the aur agar dil lag gaya toh subah ho jaati thi aur phir pichli raat ko Janab-e-Bari mein gar-garakar tauba-e-istighfaar karte the. Hazrat Ahnaf bin Qais is ayat ka yeh matlab bayan kar ke phir farmate the: Afsos mujh mein yeh baat nahi! 

Aap ke shagird Hasan Basri (R.H) ka qaul hai ke aap aksar farmaya karte the: Jannatiyon ke jo aamaal aur jo sifaat bayan hue hain, main jab kabhi apne aamaal-o-sifaat ko un ke muqable mein rakhta hoon toh bahut kuch faasla pata hoon. Lekin Alhamdulillah, jahannumiyon ke aqaaid ke bil-muqabil jab main apne aqaaid ko lata hoon toh main dekhta hoon ke woh log toh bilkul hi khair se khali the, woh Kitabullah ke munkar, woh Rasulullah (ﷺ) ke munkar, woh maut ke baad ki zindagi ke munkar; pas hamari toh haalat wahi hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne is qisam ke logon ki batai hai: Khalata amalan salihan wa akharu sayyi'an asallahu an yatuba alaihim inna Allaha Ghafoorur Rahim (Surah At-Tawbah: 102). Yaani nekiyan badiyan mili juli.

Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam se qabeela Banu Tamim ke ek shakhs ne kaha, "Aiye Abu Salma! Yeh sifat toh hum mein nahi pai jati ke hum raat ko bahut kam sote hon, balki hum toh bahut kam waqt ibaadat Allah mein guzaarte hain." Toh aap ne farmaya, "Woh shakhs bhi bahut hi khush naseeb hai jo neend aaye toh so jaye aur jaage toh Allah se darta rahe." 

Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam farmate hain, "Jab shuru shuru mein Rasool Allah ﷺ Madina Shareef mein tashreef laaye, toh log aap ki ziyarat ke liye toot pade aur is majma mein main bhi tha. Wallah! Aap ke mubarak chehra par nazar padte hi itna toh maine yaqin kar liya ke yeh noorani chehra kisi jhoote insaan ka nahi ho sakta."

Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam farmate hain, "Jab shuru shuru mein Rasool Allah ﷺ Madina Shareef mein tashreef laaye, toh log aap ki ziyarat ke liye toot pade aur is majma mein main bhi tha. Wallah! Aap ke mubarak chehra par nazar padte hi itna toh maine yaqin kar liya ke yeh noorani chehra kisi jhoote insaan ka nahi ho sakta." 

Sab se pehli baat jo Rasool Kareem ﷺ ki mere kaan mein padi yeh thi ke aap ne yeh farmaya, "Aiye logo! Khana khilate raho aur silah rehmi karte raho aur salam kiya karo aur raaton ko jab log soye hue hon namaz ada karo, toh tum salamati ke sath jannat mein dakhil ho jaoge." 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke jannat mein aise baala khane hain jin ke andar ka hissa baahar se aur baahar ka hissa andar se nazar aata hai. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari ne farmaya, "Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Yeh kin ke liye hain?" Farmaya, "Un ke liye jo narm kalaam karein aur dusron ko khilate pilate rahein aur jab log sote hon yeh namazein padhein." 

Hazrat Zuhri aur Hazrat Hasan farmate hain is aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke woh raat ka aksar hissa tahajjud guzaari mein nikaal karte hain. Hazrat Ibn Abbas aur Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke raat ka bahut kam hissa woh sote hain. Hazrat Dahhak (Kanu qalila) ko is se pehle ke jumle ke sath milate hain aur (Minal-lail) se ibtida batate hain, lekin is qaul mein bahut doori aur takalluf hai. 

Phir Allah Azza-wa-Jal irshad farmata hai: Sahar ke waqt woh istighfar karte hain. Mujahid waghairah farmate hain yaani namaz padhte hain aur mufassireen farmate hain raaton ko qiyam karte hain aur subah ke hone ke waqt apne gunaahon ki muaafi talab karte hain, jaise aur jagah farman-e-bari hai: Ayat (Wal-mustaghfirina bil-ashtar) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 17) yaani sahar ke waqt yeh log istighfar karne lag jaate hain. 

Agar yeh istighfar namaz mein hi ho toh bhi bahut acha hai. Sihah waghairah mein sahaba ki ek jama'at ki kayi riwayaton se sabit hai ke Rasool Maqbool ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab aakhri tihai raat baqi reh jaati hai, us waqt Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala har raat ko aasman-e-dunya ki taraf utarta hai aur farmata hai: Koi gunahgaar hai? Jo tauba kare aur main us ki tauba qabool karoon. Koi istighfar karne wala hai? Jo istighfar kare aur main use bakhshun. Koi mangne wala hai? Jo maange aur main use doon." Fajr ke طلوع (tulu) hone tak yehi farmata hai. 

Aksar mufassireen ne farmaya ke Nabiyullah Hazrat Yaqoob ne apne ladkon se jo farmaya tha ke aayat (Sawfa astaghfiru lakum Rabbi innahu Huwal-Ghafoor-ur-Raheem) (12. Yusuf: 98) "Main ab anqareeb tumhare liye istighfar karunga," is se bhi matlab yehi tha ke sahar ka waqt jab aayega tab istighfar karunga.

Phir un ka yeh wasaf bayan kiya jata hai kay jahan yeh namazi hain aur haq-e-Allah ada karte hain wahan logon ke haq bhi nahi bhoolte, zakat dete hain, sulook, ehsan aur silah-e-rahmi karte hain. In ke maal mein aik muqarrara hissa mangne walon aur un haqdaroon ka hai jo sawal se bachte hain. Abu Dawood waghera mein hai, Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ farmate hain: Sail ka haq hai go woh ghor sawar ho. (Mahroom) woh hai jis ka koi hissa Bait-ul-Mal mein na ho, khud us ke paas koi kaam kaj na ho, sanat-o-hirfat yaad na ho jis se rozi kama sake. 

Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa R.A farmati hain: Is se murad woh log hain ke kuch silsila kamane ka kar rakha hai lekin itna nahi pate ke unhe kafi ho jaye. Hazrat Dahhak farmate hain: Woh shakhs jo maldar tha lekin maal tabah ho gaya, chunache Yamamah mein jab pani ki tughyani aayi aur aik shakhs ka tamam maal asbab baha le gayi to aik Sahabi ne farmaya yeh mahroom hai. Aur buzurg mufassireen farmate hain: Mahroom se murad woh shakhs hai jo hajat ke bawajood kisi se sawal nahi karta. 

Aik hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: Miskeen sirf woh log nahi jo ghoomte phirte hain aur jinhe aik do luqme ya aik do khajooren tum de diya karte ho, balke haqeeqat mein woh log bhi miskeen hain jo itna nahi pate ke unhe hajat na rahe, apna haal-o-qaal aisa rakhte hain ke kisi par un ki hajat-o-aflas zahir ho aur koi unhe sadqa de (Bukhari o Muslim). 

Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H Makkah Sharif ja rahe the ke raste mein aik kutta paas aa kar khada ho gaya, aap ne zibah karda bakri ka aik shana kaat kar us ki taraf daal diya aur farmaya log kehte hain yeh bhi mahroom mein se hain. 

Hazrat Sha'bi farmate hain: Main to aajiz aa gaya lekin mahroom ke maani maloom na kar saka. 

Imam Ibn Jareer farmate hain: Mahroom woh hai jis ke paas maal na raha ho, khwah wajah kuch bhi ho. Yaani hasil hi na kar saka, kamane khane ka saleeqa hi na ho, ya kaam hi na chalta ho, ya kisi aafat ke baais jama shuda maal zaya ho gaya ho waghera. 

Aik martaba Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne aik chhota sa lashkar kafiron ki sarkoobi ke liye rawana farmaya, Allah ne unhe ghalba diya aur maal-e-ghaneemat bhi mila, phir kuch log aap ke paas woh bhi aa gaye jo ghanimat hasil hone ke waqt mojood na the, pas yeh ayat utri. Is ka iqtiza to yeh hai ke yeh Madani ho lekin darasal aisa nahi balke yeh ayat Makki hai. 

Phir farmata hai: Yaqeen rakhne walon ke liye zameen mein bhi bohat se nishanat-e-qudrat mojood hain jo Khaliq ki azmat-o-izzat, haibat-o-jalalat par dalalat karte hain. Dekho ke kis tarah is mein hawanat aur nabatat ko phaila diya hai aur kis tarah is mein paharon, maidanon, samundaron aur daryon ko rawan kiya hai. Phir insan par nazar dalo, un ke zubanon ke ikhtilaf ko, un ke rang-o-roop ke ikhtilaf ko, un ke iradon aur quwwaton ke ikhtilaf ko, un ki aql-o-fahm ke ikhtilaf ko, un ki harkat-o-sakanat ko, un ki neki badi ko dekho, un ki banawat par ghor karo ke har uzu kaisi munasib jagah hai.

Isi liye uske baad hi farmaya khud tumhare wajood mein hi iski bahut si nishaniyan hain. Kya tum dekhte nahi ho? Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain jo shakhs apni paidaish mein ghaor karega apne jodon ki tarkeb par nazar daalega woh yaqeen karlega ke beshak ise Allah ne hi paida kiya aur apni ibaadat ke liye hi banaya hai. Phir farmata hai aasmaan mein tumhari rozi hai yaani baarish aur woh bhi jiska tumse wada kiya jata hai yaani Jannat, Hazrat Wasil Ahdab ne is ayat ki tilaawat ki aur farmaya afsos mera rizq toh aasmaano mein hai aur main ise zameen mein talaash kar raha hoon? Yeh keh kar basti chhodi ujaad jangal mein chale gaye. Teen din tak toh unhe kuch bhi na mila lekin teesre din dekhte hain ke tar khajuroon ka ek khosha unke paas rakha hua hai. Unke bhai sath hi the dono bhai aakhri dam tak isi tarah janglo mein rahe. Phir Allah Kareem khud apni qasam kha kar farmata hai ke mere jo waade hain masalan Qiyamat ke din dobara zinda karne ka jaza saza ka yeh yaqeenan sarasar sachche aur qatan beshabah ho kar rehne wale hain, jaise tumhari zubaan se nikle hue alfaaz mein shak nahi hota usi tarah tumhe in mein bhi koi shak hargiz hargiz nahi karna chahiye. Hazrat Muaz jab koi baat kehte toh farmate yeh bilkul haq hai jaise ke tera yahan hona haq hai. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Allah unhe barbaad kare jo Allah ki qasam ko bhi na maane yeh hadith mursal hai yaani tabi Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se riwayat karte hain. Sahabi ka naam nahi lete.

Hasan-e-Karkardagi ke Inaamat: Parhezgaar Allah se darne wale logon ka anjaam bayan ho raha hai ke yeh Qiyamat ke din jannaton mein aur nahron mein honge, ba-khilaf un bad-kirdaaron ke jo azaab-o-saza, tauq-o-zanjeer, sakhti aur maar-peet mein honge. Jo faraaiz-e-Ilahi un ke paas aaye the yeh un ke aamil the aur un se pehle bhi woh ikhlaas se kaam karne wale the. Lekin is tafsir mein zara tamammul hai do wajah se: Awwal toh yeh ke yeh tafsir Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki kahi jaati hai lekin sanad sahih se un tak nahi pahunchti balki is ki yeh sanad bilkul zaeef hai. Doosre yeh ke (Akhizeen) ka laafz haal hai agle jumle se, toh yeh matlab hua ke muttaqi log jannat mein Allah ki di hui naimatein haasil kar rahe honge is se pehle woh bhalayi ke kaam karne wale the yaani duniya mein, jaise Allah Ta'ala Jala Jalaluhu ne aur aayaton mein farmaya, ayat: Kulu washrabu haniam bima aslaftum fil-ayyamil-khaliyah (Surah Al-Haaqqah: 24). Baaz mafassireen kehte hain yahan (maa) nafiya hai toh ba-qaul Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera yeh matlab hoga ke un par koi raat aisi na guzarti thi jis ka kuch hissa yaad-e-Ilahi mein na guzaarte hon, khwah awwal waqt mein kuch nawafil parh lein khwah darmiyan mein. Aap ke mubarak chehra par nazar padte hi itna toh maine yaqin kar liya ke yeh noorani chehra kisi jhoote insaan ka nahi ho sakta."

Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke jannat mein aise baala khane hain jin ke andar ka hissa baahar se aur baahar ka hissa andar se nazar aata hai. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari ne farmaya, "Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Yeh kin ke liye hain?" Aal-e-Imran: 17) yaani sahar ke waqt yeh log istighfar karne lag jaate hain.

Fajr ke طلوع (tulu) hone tak yehi farmata hai.

Baaz mafassireen kehte hain yahan (maa) nafiya hai toh ba-qaul Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera yeh matlab hoga ke un par koi raat aisi na guzarti thi jis ka kuch hissa yaad-e-Ilahi mein na guzaarte hon, khwah awwal waqt mein kuch nawafil parh lein khwah darmiyan mein. Yaani kuch na kuch kisi na kisi waqt namaz umoman har raat parh hi liya karte the, sari raat sotay sotay nahi guzaarte the. Hazrat Abul Aliyah waghera farmate hain yeh log Maghrib-o-Isha ke darmiyan kuch nawafil parh liya karte the. Imam Abu Jafar Baqir farmate hain murad yeh hai ke Isha ki namaz parhne se pehle nahi sotay the. Lekin Alhamdulillah, jahannumiyon ke aqaaid ke bil-muqabil jab main apne aqaaid ko lata hoon toh main dekhta hoon ke woh log toh bilkul hi khair se khali the, woh Kitabullah ke munkar, woh Rasulullah (ﷺ) ke munkar, woh maut ke baad ki zindagi ke munkar; pas hamari toh haalat wahi hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne is qisam ke logon ki batai hai: Khalata amalan salihan wa akharu sayyi'an asallahu an yatuba alaihim inna Allaha Ghafoorur Rahim (Surah At-Tawbah: 102). Yaani nekiyan badiyan mili juli.

Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam se qabeela Banu Tamim ke ek shakhs ne kaha, "Aiye Abu Salma! Yeh sifat toh hum mein nahi pai jati ke hum raat ko bahut kam sote hon, balki hum toh bahut kam waqt ibaadat Allah mein guzaarte hain." Toh aap ne farmaya, "Woh shakhs bhi bahut hi khush naseeb hai jo neend aaye toh so jaye aur jaage toh Allah se darta rahe." 

Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam farmate hain, "Jab shuru shuru mein Rasool Allah ﷺ Madina Shareef mein tashreef laaye, toh log aap ki ziyarat ke liye toot pade aur is majma mein main bhi tha. Wallah! Aap ke mubarak chehra par nazar padte hi itna toh maine yaqin kar liya ke yeh noorani chehra kisi jhoote insaan ka nahi ho sakta." 

Sab se pehli baat jo Rasool Kareem ﷺ ki mere kaan mein padi yeh thi ke aap ne yeh farmaya, "Aiye logo! Khana khilate raho aur silah rehmi karte raho aur salam kiya karo aur raaton ko jab log soye hue hon namaz ada karo, toh tum salamati ke sath jannat mein dakhil ho jaoge." 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke jannat mein aise baala khane hain jin ke andar ka hissa baahar se aur baahar ka hissa andar se nazar aata hai. Farmaya, "Un ke liye jo narm kalaam karein aur dusron ko khilate pilate rahein aur jab log sote hon yeh namazein padhein."

Hazrat Dahhak (Kanu qalila) ko is se pehle ke jumle ke sath milate hain aur (Minal-lail) se ibtida batate hain, lekin is qaul mein bahut doori aur takalluf hai.

Mujahid waghairah farmate hain yaani namaz padhte hain aur mufassireen farmate hain raaton ko qiyam karte hain aur subah ke hone ke waqt apne gunaahon ki muaafi talab karte hain, jaise aur jagah farman-e-bari hai: Ayat (Wal-mustaghfirina bil-ashtar) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 17) yaani sahar ke waqt yeh log istighfar karne lag jaate hain. 

Agar yeh istighfar namaz mein hi ho toh bhi bahut acha hai. Jo tauba kare aur main us ki tauba qabool karoon. Koi istighfar karne wala hai? Jo istighfar kare aur main use bakhshun. Koi mangne wala hai? Jo maange aur main use doon." Fajr ke طلوع (tulu) hone tak yehi farmata hai. 

Aksar mufassireen ne farmaya ke Nabiyullah Hazrat Yaqoob ne apne ladkon se jo farmaya tha ke aayat (Sawfa astaghfiru lakum Rabbi innahu Huwal-Ghafoor-ur-Raheem) (12. Yusuf: 98) "Main ab anqareeb tumhare liye istighfar karunga," is se bhi matlab yehi tha ke sahar ka waqt jab aayega tab istighfar karunga.

Phir insan par nazar dalo, un ke zubanon ke ikhtilaf ko, un ke rang-o-roop ke ikhtilaf ko, un ke iradon aur quwwaton ke ikhtilaf ko, un ki aql-o-fahm ke ikhtilaf ko, un ki harkat-o-sakanat ko, un ki neki badi ko dekho, un ki banawat par ghor karo ke har uzu kaisi munasib jagah hai.

Unhon ne salam kiya jis ka jawab Khalilullah (A.S) ne barha kar diya, is ka suboot dusre salam par do pesh ka hona hai. Aur yahi farman-e-Bari Ta'ala hai, farmata hai (Wa iza huyyitum bi-tahiyyatin fa-hayyu bi-ahsana minha aw rudduha, innallaha kana ala kulli shayin hasiba) (Surah An-Nisa: 86), yani jab koi tumhein salam kare to tum us se behtar jawab do ya kam-az-kam utna hi. Pas Khalilullah (A.S) ne afzal surat ko ikhtiyar kiya. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) chunke is se nawaqif thay ke yeh darasal farishtay hain is liye kaha ke yeh log to na-ashna sa hain. Yeh farishtay Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S), Hazrat Mikaeel (A.S) aur Hazrat Israfeel (A.S) thay, jo khubsurat naujawan insanon ki shakl mein aaye thay, un ke chehron par haibat-o-jalal tha. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ab un ke liye khanay ki tayari mein masroof ho gaye aur chup-chap bahut jald apne ghar walon ki taraf gaye aur zara si der mein tayar bachray ka gosht bhuna-bhunaya hua le aaye aur un ke samne rakh diya aur farmaya aap khatay kyun nahin? Is se ziyafat ke adab maloom hue ke mehman se poochay baghair hi un par shuru se ehsan rakhne se pehle aap chup-chap unhein khabar kiye baghair hi chale gaye aur ba-ajlat behtar se behtar jo cheez payi use tayar kar ke le aaye. Tayar farba kam-umar bachray ka bhuna hua gosht le aaye aur kahin aur rakh kar mehman ki kheench-taan na ki balkay un ke samne un ke paas la kar rakha. Phir unhein yun nahin kehte ke khao kyunke is mein bhi ek hukm paya jata hai balkay nihayat tawazo aur pyar se farmatay hain aap tanawul farmana shuru kyun nahin karte? Jaise koi shakhs kisi se kahe ke agar aap fazl-o-karam, ehsan-o-sulook karna chahein to kijiye. Phir irshad hota hai ke Khalilullah (A.S) apne dil mein un se khaufzada ho gaye jaise ke aur ayat mein hai, ayat (Falamma ra'a aydiyahum la tasilu ilaihi nakirahum wa awjasa minhum khifah, qalu la takhaf inna ursilna ila qawmi Lut) (Surah Hud: 70), yani aap ne jab dekha ke un ke haath khanay ki taraf barhte nahin to dehshat-zada ho gaye aur dil mein khauf khanay lage. Is par mehmanon ne kaha daro mat hum Allah ke bheje hue farishtay hain jo qoum-e-Lut ki halakat ke liye aaye hain. Aap ki biwi sahiba jo khari hui sun rahi thin woh sun kar hans din to farishton ne unhein khushkhabri sunayi ke tumhare haan Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) paida honge aur un ke haan Hazrat Yaqub (A.S). Is par biwi sahiba ko ta'ajjub hua aur kaha haye afsos ab mere haan bacha kaise hoga? Main to burhiya phoos ho gayi hoon aur mere shohar bhi bilkul burhay ho gaye.

Yeh sakht-tar ta'ajjub ki cheez hai. Farishton ne kaha kya tum Allah ke kaamon se ta'ajjub karti ho? Khusoosan tum jaisi aisi paak gharane ki aurat? Tum par Allah ki rahmatain aur barkatain nazil hon. Jaan rakho ke Allah Ta'ala tareefon ke laiq aur badi buzurgi aur aala shaan wala hai. Yahan yeh farmaya gaya hai ke basharat Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ko di gayi kyunke bachay ka hona dono ki khushi ka mujib hai. Phir farmata hai yeh basharat sun kar aap ki ahliya sahiba ke munh se zor ki aawaz nikal gayi aur apne tayin dohatar maar kar aisi ajeeb-o-ghareeb khabar ko sun kar hairat ke sath kehne lagin ke jawani mein toh main banjh rahi ab miyan biwi dono boodhay ho gaye toh mujhe hamal thehray ga? Is ke jawab mein farishton ne kaha ke yeh khushkhabri kuch hum apni taraf se nahin de rahe balkay Allah Ta'ala ne hamain farmaya hai ke hum tumhain yeh khabar pohanchayain. Woh hikmat wala aur ilm wala hai. Tum jis izzat-o-karamat ke mustahiq ho woh khoob jaanta hai aur us ka farman hai ke tumharay han is umar mein bacha hoga, us ka koi kaam hikmat se khali nahin na us ka koi farman hikmat se khali hai. Alhamdulillah! Alhamdulillah! Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam aur us ke lutf-o-rahm se Tafsir-e-Muhammadi ka chabeeswan para 'Ha-Meem' bhi khatam hua. Allah Ta'ala hum sab ko apne kalam-e-paak ka sahih aur haqeeqi matlab samjhaye aur phir us par amal karne ki tofeeq de. Aye Parwardigar-e-Alam jis tarah tu ne mujh par apna yeh fazl kiya hai ke apne kalam ki khidmat mujh se li isi tarah yeh bhi fazl kar ke isay qabool farma aur mere liye baqiyat-e-salihat mein isay kar le. Aur is tafsir ko meri taqseer ki maafi ka sabab bana de, apne tamam bandon ko is se faida pohancha aur sab ko amal-e-saleh ki tofeeq ata farma. Ameen.

Unhone jawab diya ki Qaum-e-Lut ke gunehgaaron ko takht-o-taaraj karne ke liye humein bhi bheja gaya hai, hum un par sangbaari aur pathraao karenge, in pathron ko un par barsaayenge jin par Allah ke hukum se pehle hi un ke naam likhe ja chuke hain aur har ek gunehgaar ke liye alag alag pathar muqarrar kar diye gaye hain. Isi tarah yahan bhi irshad hai ki is basti mein jitne bhi Momin thay sab ko bacha diya gaya ki wahan siwaye ek ghar ke aur koi ghar Musalman tha hi nahi. Hum ne un ki taraf apne Kaleem paighambar Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko roshan daleelein aur wazeh burhan de kar bheja, lekin un ke sardar Firaun ne, jo takabbur ka mujassama tha, haq ke manne se inad kiya aur hamare farman ko be-parwahi se taal diya. Is dushman-e-Ilahi ne apni taqat-o-quwwat ke ghamand par, apne lao-lashkar ke bal-boote par Rab ke farman ki izzat na ki aur apne logon ko apne sath mila kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki eeza-rasani par utar aaya aur kehne laga ke Musa (A.S) ya to jadugar hai ya deewana hai. Pas is malamati kafir, fajir, muanid mutakabbir shakhs ko hum ne us ke lao-lashkar samet darya-burd kar diya.

Isi tarah Aadiyon ke sarasar ibrat-nak waqiat bhi tumhare gosh-guzar ho chuke hain, jin ki siyah-kariyon ke wabal mein un par be-barkat hawayein bheji gayin, jin hawaon ne sab ke huliye bigad diye. Ek lipat jis cheez ko lag gayi woh gali-sari haddi ki tarah ho gayi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki hadith mein hai, Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Hawa dusri zameen mein musakhkhar hai, jab Allah Ta'ala ne Aadiyon ko halak karna chaha to hawa ke darogha ko hukum diya ke un ki tabahi ke liye hawayein chala do. Farishte ne kaha: Kya hawaon ke khazane mein itna wazan kar doon jitna bail ka nathna hota hai? Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya: Nahin, agar itna wazan kar diya to zameen ko aur is kainat ko ulat degi, balkeh itna wazan karo jitna angoothi ka halqa hota hai. Yeh thin woh hawayein jo ke jahan jahan se guzar gayin tamam cheezon ko teh-o-bala karti gayin. Is hadith ka farman-e-Rasool hona to munkar hai, samajh se zyada qareeb baat yahi hai ke yeh Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) ka qaul hai. Yarmouk ki ladai mein unhein do boray Ahl-e-Kitab ki kitabon ke mile thay, mumkin hai unhi mein se yeh baat aap ne bayan farmayi ho, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh hawayein janubi thin, Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain: Meri madad pur-wa hawaon se ki gayi hai aur Aadi pachwa hawaon se halak hue hain.

Theek isi tarah Thamudiyon ke halaat par aur un ke anjam par gaur karo ke un se keh diya gaya ke ek waqt-e-muqarrara tak to tum faida uthao, jaise aur jagah farmaya hai. Thamudiyon ko hum ne hidayat di lekin unhon ne hidayat par zalalat ko pasand kiya, jis ke baais zillat ke azab ki holnak cheekh ne un ke patte pani kar diye aur kaleje phaad diye. Yeh sirf un ki sarkashi, sartabi, nafarmani aur siyah-kari ka badla tha.

Un par un ke dekhte dekhte Azab-e-Ilahi aa gaya. Teen din tak toh yeh intezar mein rahe, azab ke asar dekhte rahe. Aakhir chauthe din subh hi subh Rabb ka azab daf'atan aa pada. Hawas bakhta ho gaye, koi tadbeer na ban padi. Itni bhi mohlat na mili ke khade ho kar bhagne ki koshish toh karte ya kisi aur tarah apne bachao ki kuch toh fikr kar sakte. Isi tarah un se pehle Qaum-e-Nuh bhi hamare azab chakh chuki hai, apni badkari aur khuli nafarmani ka khamyaza woh bhi bhugat chuki hai. Tabligh mein sabr-o-zabt ki अहमियत (ahmiyat)
Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ ko tasalli dete hue farmata hai ke kuffar jo aap ko kehte hain woh koi nayi baat nahi, un se pehle ke kafiron ne bhi apne apne zamane ke rasolon se yahi kaha hai. Kafiron ka yeh qaul silsila-ba-silsila yoonhi chala aaya hai jaise aapas mein ek dusre ko wasiyat kar ke jata ho. Sach toh yeh hai ke sarkashi aur sartabi mein yeh sab yaksan hain, is liye jo baat pehle walon ke munh se nikli wahi in ki zuban se nikalti hai kyunke sakht dili mein sab ek se hain. Pas aap chashm-poshi kijiye, yeh majnoon kaheen, jadugar kaheen, aap sabr-o-zabt se sun len, haan naseeyat ki tabligh na chhoriye, Allah ki baatein pehchante chale jayiye. Jin dilon mein iman ki qubuliyat ka mada hai woh ek na ek roz rah par lag jayenge.

Phir Allah Ta'ala Jal Jalalahu ka farman hai ke maine insanon aur jinon ko kisi apni zarurat ke liye nahi paida kiya balki sirf is liye ke main unhe un ke nafa ke liye apni ibadat ka hukm dun, woh khushi na-khushi mere ma'bud-e-barhaq hone ka iqrar karen, mujhe pehchanein. 

Hazrat Suddi farmate hain: Ba'z ibadatein nafa deti hain aur ba'z ibadatein bilkul nafa nahi pohnchati hain, jaise Quran mein ek jagah hai ke agar tum in kafiron se pucho ke asman-o-zamin ko kis ne paida kiya hai? Toh yeh jawab denge ke Allah Ta'ala ne. Toh go yeh bhi ibadat hai magar mushrikon ko kaam na aayegi. Gharesh 'abid sab hain khwah ibadat un ke liye nafi' ho ya na ho. Aur Hazrat Zahhak farmate hain: Is se murad musalman insan aur iman wale jinnat hain.

Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud farmate hain: Mujhe Rasulullah ﷺ ne yoon parhaya hai, hadith:
(اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِيْنُ) (Adh-Zhariyat: 58)
Yeh hadith Abu Dawud, Tirmizi aur Nasai mein bhi hai, Imam Tirmizi isay Hasan Sahih batate hain.

Garz Allah Ta'ala ne apne bandon ko bandagi ke liye paida kiya hai ab uski ibadat yaksui ke sath jo baja layega kisi ko uska sharik na karega woh use puri puri jaza inayat farmayega aur jo uski na-furmani karega aur uske sath kisi ko sharik karega woh bad-tareen sazayein bhagatega Allah kisi ka mohtaj nahi balki kul makhlooq har haal aur har waqt mein uski puri mohtaj hai balki mahz be-dast-o-pa aur sarasar faqeer hai khaliq razak akela Allah Ta'ala hi hai, Musnad Ahmad mein Hadis-e-Qudsi hai ke Ae Ibn-e-Adam meri ibadat ke liye farig hoja main tera seena tongari aur be-niyazi se pur kar dunga aur teri fakeeri rok dunga aur agar tune aisa na kiya toh main tere seene ko ashgal se bhar dunga aur teri fakeeri ko hargiz band na karunga Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh hadis-e-shareef hai, Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Ghareeb kehte hain Khalid ke dono larke Hazrat Huba aur Hazrat Sawa R.A farmate hain hum An-Hazrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue us waqt aap kisi kaam mein mashghool the ya koi deewar bana rahe the ya kisi cheez ko durust kar rahe the hum bhi usi kaam mein lag gaye jab kaam khatam hua toh aap ne hamein dua di aur farmaya sar hil jaane tak rozi se mayoos na hona dekho insan jab paida hota hai ek surkh boti hota hai badan par ek chhalka bhi nahi hota phir Allah Ta'ala use sab kuch deta hai (Musnad Ahmad) ba'z asmani kitabon mein hai Ae Ibn-e-Adam maine tujhe apni ibadat ke liye paida kiya hai isliye tu isse ghaflat na kar tere rizq ka main zamin hoon tu ismein be-ja takleef na kar mujhe dhoond taaki mujhe paale jab tu ne mujhe pa liya toh yaqeen maan ke tu ne sab kuch pa liya aur agar mujhe tu na mila toh samajh le ke tamam bhalaiyan tu kho chuka sun tamam cheezon se ziyada mohabbat tere dil mein meri honi chahiye. Phir farmata hai yeh kafir mere azab ko jaldi kyun maang rahe hain? Woh azab toh unhe apne waqt par pahunch kar hi rahenge jaise unse pehle ke kafiron ko poche

Garz Allah Ta'ala ne apne bandon ko bandagi ke liye paida kiya hai ab uski ibadat yaksui ke sath jo baja layega kisi ko uska sharik na karega woh use puri puri jaza inayat farmayega aur jo uski na-furmani karega aur uske sath kisi ko sharik karega woh bad-tareen sazayein bhagatega Allah kisi ka mohtaj nahi balki kul makhlooq har haal aur har waqt mein uski puri mohtaj hai balki mahz be-dast-o-pa aur sarasar faqeer hai khaliq razak akela Allah Ta'ala hi hai, Musnad Ahmad mein Hadis-e-Qudsi hai ke Ae Ibn-e-Adam meri ibadat ke liye farig hoja main tera seena tongari aur be-niyazi se pur kar dunga aur teri fakeeri rok dunga aur agar tune aisa na kiya toh main tere seene ko ashgal se bhar dunga aur teri fakeeri ko hargiz band na karunga Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh hadis-e-shareef hai, Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Ghareeb kehte hain Khalid ke dono larke Hazrat Huba aur Hazrat Sawa R.A farmate hain hum An-Hazrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue us waqt aap kisi kaam mein mashghool the ya koi deewar bana rahe the ya kisi cheez ko durust kar rahe the hum bhi usi kaam mein lag gaye jab kaam khatam hua toh aap ne hamein dua di aur farmaya sar hil jaane tak rozi se mayoos na hona dekho insan jab paida hota hai ek surkh boti hota hai badan par ek chhalka bhi nahi hota phir Allah Ta'ala use sab kuch deta hai (Musnad Ahmad) ba'z asmani kitabon mein hai Ae Ibn-e-Adam maine tujhe apni ibadat ke liye paida kiya hai isliye tu isse ghaflat na kar tere rizq ka main zamin hoon tu ismein be-ja takleef na kar mujhe dhoond taaki mujhe paale jab tu ne mujhe pa liya toh yaqeen maan ke tu ne sab kuch pa liya aur agar mujhe tu na mila toh samajh le ke tamam bhalaiyan tu kho chuka sun tamam cheezon se ziyada mohabbat tere dil mein meri honi chahiye. Phir farmata hai yeh kafir mere azab ko jaldi kyun maang rahe hain? Woh azab toh unhe apne waqt par pahunch kar hi rahenge jaise unse pehle ke kafiron ko poche
